description: This source file implements a command-line utility for controlling screen recording in the Cuttlefish Android emulator environment. It processes 'start' and 'stop' commands to initiate or halt screen recording via launcher actions, utilizing configuration and communication with the launcher socket.

methods.name: RecordCvdMain
methods.description: Main function handling the 'record_cvd' command, parsing arguments, configuring actions, and executing the start or stop screen recording commands.
